answer: Here is one mechanism: the juries that flag duplicates are sampled in proportion to earned reputation, fresh identities almost never get a seat, and every verdict carries a written reason visible to the panel. The required words slot into it cleanly: signal embodies the transparency that makes every pattern visible, glacier mirrors the random sampling that seats juries, and harbor stands for the slashing that punishes duplicate work. Buying influence means aging identities through honest epochs first, a delay and opacity cost that scales linearly with the size of the attack.
